items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The Yowl Man? [INTERVIEWEE] The Yeah Man.

ctx.x: No, I never made a session. I used to -- most of the time, Walter Fuller and I used to hang out at the 'Yeah Man.'
The Yeah Man. That's where Billie Holiday was signing. She started out, her uncle was playing banjo and the guitar. Boy, and that chick used to -- boy, she used to kill us. We was there every night.
